units.source_text: 還有一句話叫「犯罪意識」，活在這人世間，我一生都遭受這種意識的折磨，

en.t: There is also a phrase called "criminal consciousness"; living in this human world, I have been tormented by that consciousness all my life,

units.source_text: 可它又好像是我糟糠之妻一樣的好伴侶，脣齒相依，與我耍鬧著孤寂的遊戲，

en.t: yet it also seems to be a good companion to me, like a wife who has shared my hardships, as close as lips and teeth, playing lonely games with me,

units.source_text: 這也算是我活著的另一種姿態吧。

en.t: Perhaps this, too, may count as another posture of my being alive.

units.source_text: 另外，好像還有一句俗話叫「小腿有傷，心有隱疚」。

en.t: Also, there seems to be a common saying: "A wound on the shin means hidden guilt in the heart."
